seo_description: EdgeDesk prices Philadelphia Eagles at Tennessee Titans at Tennessee Titans +6.0 with a 42.0 fair total. Philadelphia Eagles wins 71% of simulations. Model status AGREEMENT. Research, not picks.

market_source: The sportsbook number on this page is a quote EdgeDesk captured at Caesars and FanDuel on 2026-09-13, replayed from a committed snapshot rather than read live. It is the book’s number, not EdgeDesk’s, and EdgeDesk’s own number was produced before it was read. Source: EdgeDesk odds capture (public.signals), read by the newsletter pipeline.

lede: Philadelphia Eagles carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#17 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Tennessee Titans +6.0 with a fair total of 42.0 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Tennessee Titans pass offence vs Philadelphia Eagles pass defence, which sits −0.297 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
